<mxPoint x="170" y="160" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="vF5n1-W-f8WOHR8bm62p-4" value="Telemetry Message<br>1 row = 1 observation = 1 message as sent from a device<br><br>Engine Trip<br>1 row = 1 continuous time period of 1 vehicle in which engine is on<br>1:M to Telemetry Message - All messages of a vehicle in the mentioned trip time period belongs to the trip<br>1:1 to Engine Trip Statistics - All trip has only 1 statistic entity. Trip w/o statistic entity may exists only as temporary state during computation<br>1:M(Optional) to Engine Trip Events - Multiple kinds of events and multiple instance of same kind of events may exists for a trip<br><br><br>Driver Trip<br>1 row = 1 continuous time period of 1 vehicle-driver pair in which the driver drive the vehicle<br>(It is possible for a vehicle to engine on continuously but swap driver, for example)<br>Some vehicle has no driver identification module, thus driver trip and all driver related information cannot be extracted.<br><br>1:M to Telemetry Message by definition<br>1:1 to Driver Trip Statistics<br>1:M(Optional) to Driver Trip Events&nbsp;" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;" computed statistics which represent the whole (engine trip / driver trip)<br><br>(Engine Trip / Driver Trip) Events<br>Entity contain an event of interest which, by the definition of the event type, can only occur during a (engine trip / driver trip)<br><br><br>(Vehicle / Driver) Events<br>Entity contain an event of interest which, by the definition of the event type, belong to the (vehicle / driver), but does not belong to any specific trips." style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry
